name: Administration Node
summary: An office suite that increases a hab's economic output and our faction's overall efficiency.

name: Administration Tower
summary: Offices dedicated to increasing a hab's economic output and our faction's overall efficiency.

name: Administration Complex
summary: A large management center for a hab.

name: Antimatter Trap
summary: A magnetic collector of naturally occurring antimatter in the magnetic fields around large planets.

name: Antimatter Harvester
summary: A platform and control center for deploying magnetic loops able to mine antimatter from a planet's magnetic field.

name: Antimatter Farm
summary: A large-scale mining center that employs plasma loops to gather naturally occurring antimatter in the magnetic field of a large planet.

name: Automated Fission Pile
summary: A self-operating fission reactor for our automated habs.

name: Automated Mining Complex
summary: A robotic mine, refinery and electromagnetic catapult.

name: Automated Outpost Core
summary: An AI hub for managing a small surface base without a human presence on site.

name: Automated Platform Core
summary: A computer core for managing operations on a small uncrewed station.

name: Automated Solar Collector
summary: A crewless solar power module for automated habitats.

name: Automated Supply Depot
summary: A self-service automated module for resupplying propellant and munitions.

name: Broadcast Outlet
summary: A simple media station for communicating our efforts to humanity.

name: Communications Hub
summary: A large broadcast node that tells our story to the world.

name: Media Center
summary: A battery of studios and communications arrays transmitting our message via news and entertainment channels in dozens of languages.

name: Climate Lab
summary: A small station module that monitors changing environmental conditions on Earth.

name: Climate Research Center
summary: A sizable station module combining meteorology, oceanography, forestry, and other Earth science disciplines.

name: Climate Institute
summary: A large space station module devoting to studying threats to Earth's environment.

name: Construction Module
summary: Accelerates construction of modules at a hab and allows founding additional Platforms and Outposts in this planetary/asteroidal system.

name: Nanofactory
summary: Speeds the construction of modules at a hab and allows founding additional Orbitals and Settlements in a planetary/asteroidal system.

name: Nanofacturing Complex
summary: Accelerates the construction of all hab modules at a hab and allows founding additional Rings and Colonies in this planetary/asteroidal system.

name: Energy Lab
summary: A small laboratory for conducting high-energy physics experiments.

name: Energy Research Center
summary: A large lab for studying propulsion, directed energy weapons, and energy storage.

name: Energy Institute
summary: A huge laboratory complex devoted to the study of physics.

name: Fission Pile
summary: A small fission reactor that provides steady electricity to a hab.

name: Fission Reactor Array
summary: A sizable nuclear reactor capable of powering habs at any distance from the Sun.

name: Fission Reactor Farm
summary: A sprawling complex of nuclear reactors for powering a hab.

name: Fusion Pile
summary: A basic fusion reactor that provides clean, safe power to a hab.

name: Fusion Reactor Array
summary: A large fusion reactor that provides a great deal of energy to a habitat.

name: Fusion Reactor Farm
summary: A series of high-energy, efficient fusion reactors producing clean energy for a hab.

name: Heavy Fission Pile
summary: An advanced, compact fission reactor that provides power to a hab.

name: Heavy Fission Reactor Array
summary: An advanced fission reactor that provides power for a hab.

name: Heavy Fission Reactor Farm
summary: A sizable cluster of advanced fission reactors to power habitats.

name: Heavy Fusion Pile
summary: An advanced fusion reactor that provides a significant amount of power for a hab.

name: Heavy Fusion Reactor Array
summary: Advanced fusion reactors that provide vast power for a hab.

name: Heavy Fusion Reactor Farm
summary: A bank of next-generation, high-power fusion reactors to support our largest habitats.

name: Hydroponics Bay
summary: A module for growing food for our crew.

name: Farm
summary: A hydroponic farm that recycles matter into fresh food and breathable air.

name: Agriculture Complex
summary: A massive complex of hydroponic farms that moves a hab toward a degree of self-sufficiency.

name: Information Science Lab
summary: A lab for studying new computing theories and technologies.

name: Information Science Research Center
summary: A large low-gravity clean room for developing new computer technologies.

name: Information Science Institute
summary: A high-powered laboratory complex devoted to advances in computer science, data science, and intelligence gathering.

name: Life Science Lab
summary: A small research module devoted to the investigation of biology and survival in space.

name: Life Science Research Center
summary: A large biolab with facilities to study the effects of space on microbes, animals and humans.

name: Life Science Institute
summary: Large biolabs that include containment facilities and genetic engineering rapid prototyping centers.

name: Listening Post
summary: A surveillance station module that monitors communications and high-value targets on Earth.

name: Reconnaissance Array
summary: A large surveillance module for gathering intelligence from Earth.

name: Argus Complex
summary: A vast complex of intelligence-gathering equipment and analysts who monitor events on Earth.

name: Marine Platoon Barracks
summary: Houses several squads of space marines to defend our interests on a hab.

name: Marine Company Barracks
summary: Houses three platoons of space marines and a headquarters staff who defend our interests at a hab.

name: Marine Battalion Barracks
summary: Home to hundreds of space marines who can defend a hab against enemy attacks.

name: Materials Lab
summary: A lab designed to study strong new materials in low- and zero-gee environments.

name: Materials Research Center
summary: A chemistry center devoted to the creation of new armor, energy storage and other uses.

name: Materials Institute
summary: A complex of chemistry labs and testing facilities aimed at developing new substances able to withstand the rigors of space.

name: Military Science Lab
summary: A small module dedicated to developing military technologies and doctrine.

name: Military Science Research Center
summary: A center dedicated to improving our capability for warfare.

name: Military Science Institute
summary: Several battlelabs devoted to mastery of combat, logistics, and doctrine in next-generation warfare.

name: Outpost Core
summary: A basic control center for a small planetary base.

name: Settlement Core
summary: Upgrades the Outpost to a Settlement, adding two new sectors with four modules each and allowing the construction of Tier 2 modules.

name: Colony Core
summary: Upgrades the base to a Colony, with a total of five sectors, and allows the construction of Tier 3 modules.

name: Outpost Mining Complex
summary: A small but critical facility that mines and refines ore, and uses an electromagnetic catapult to deliver the product to our other habs.

name: Settlement Mining Complex
summary: A large mine, refinery, and electromagnetic catapult capable of sending processed materials to our other habs.

name: Colony Mining Complex
summary: An extensive complex of mines and refineries supported by a large catapult that extracts, processes and delivers this space body's raw materials.

name: Particle Collider
summary: A small particle accelerator that can be used for research and the creation of small amounts of antimatter.

name: Atomsmasher
summary: A particle collider used for research and the production of limited amounts of antimatter.

name: Supercollider
summary: A high-powered particle accelerator ring used to manufacture antimatter and improve our understanding of high-energy physics.

name: Platform Core
summary: The control center for a small space station.

name: Orbital Core
summary: Upgrades the Platform to an Orbital, adding two new sectors with four modules each and allowing the construction of Tier 2 modules.

name: Ring Core
summary: Upgrades the station to a Ring, with a total of five sectors, and allowing the construction of Tier 3 modules.

name: Point Defense Array
summary: A battery of defensive weaponry to protect the hab from attack. It will automatically upgrade weapons and armor as we develop new technologies.

name: Layered Defense Array
summary: A combat platform capable of defending the hab from attack. It will automatically upgrade weapons and armor as we develop new technologies.

name: Battlestations
summary: A heavily armed combat module built to withstand a substantial assault. Will automatically upgrade weapons and armor as we develop new technologies.

name: Quarters
summary: A dormitory, galley, and gym affording a small measure of comfort and occasional privacy for the hab crew.

name: Residential Module
summary: Apartments and other civilian and commercial facilities for a hab's crew and their families.

name: Civilian Complex
summary: A small town in space, offering various amenities for the crew and their families.

name: Social Science Lab
summary: A think tank hosting several researchers devoted to the study of political science, economics and communications.

name: Social Science Research Center
summary: A sizable facility aimed at expanding our knowledge of human behavior and developing policies to advance our goals.

name: Social Science Institute
summary: A full-fledged policy institute examining political, economic and sociological aspects of the new era.

name: Solar Collector
summary: A small cluster of solar panels to power a hab. Much more effective close to the Sun.

name: Solar Array
summary: A large assembly of solar panels that should provide a great deal of power when positioned close to the Sun.

name: Solar Farm
summary: A massive array of solar panels designed to maximize energy received from the Sun.

name: Solar Mirror
summary: A focusing mirror that directs extra sunlight to a point on the planet below, augmenting surface solar power module output.

name: Solar Mirror Array
summary: A large series of mirrors that focus sunlight and improve solar power module output on the planet below.

name: Soletta
summary: A large station module equipped with focusing mirrors that provide a significant bonus to solar power module outputs on the planet below.

name: Automated Solar Mirror
summary: An crewless mirror module that directs sunlight to the planet below

name: Space Dock
summary: A basic assembly platform for interplanetary space craft. Also functions as a supply depot and launches probes.

name: Shipyard
summary: A large ship construction facility, able to complete larger vessels much more quickly than at a space dock. Also functions as a supply depot and launches probes.

name: Spaceworks
summary: A massive spaceship construction facility, able to assemble our largest warships in a fraction of the time of our smaller shipyards. Also functions as a supply depot and launches probes.

name: Space Science Lab
summary: A small lab devoted to astronomy and planetary science.

name: Space Science Research Center
summary: A large astronomy and planetary science lab.

name: Space Science Institute
summary: Labs that can study our Solar System and peer into deep space with a level of detail astronomers of an earlier generation could only dream of.

name: Supply Depot
summary: A place for our ships to take on propellant, munitions and supplies.

name: Tourist Berth
summary: A hotel room in space to serve high-paying customers.

name: Space Hotel
summary: A large low-gee recreation and conference center for paying customers.

name: Space Resort
summary: The ultimate in outer space leisure for our customers.

name: Operations Center
summary: A facility staffed around-the-clock to manage our space assets around the Solar System.

name: Command Center
summary: A command, control, and communications facility for networking our space assets throughout the Solar System.

name: Medical Center
summary: A medical facility for conducting research and helping paying customers recover from illness and injuries in low or no gravity.

name: Space Hospital
summary: A large medical facility dedicated to specialized treatments only possible in low-gravity environments, with acute and long-term care wings for paying patients.

name: Research Campus
summary: A general research center run in cooperation with secondary educational institutions on Earth.

name: Research University
summary: A full-service research academy in space, devoted to developing the next generation of scholars and policymakers.

name: Skunkworks
summary: An assemblage of engineering talent dedicated to developing new modules, systems, and tools unencumbered by bureaucratic concerns.

name: Foundry
summary: A dedicated site for rapid prototyping and development of new technologies.

name: Helium-3 Mine
summary: Harvester drones gather Helium-3 fusion fuel from a gas giant for transport to our assets around the Solar Systems.
